#| label: data-explore

# This cell loads the first ABS data cube and prints sheet names and a sample of the data.
import pandas as pd
excel_path = '../source_data/abs/All data cubes/34120DO001_201920.xls'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(excel_path)
print('Sheet names:', xl.sheet_names)
# Load the first sheet as an example
df = xl.parse(xl.sheet_names[0])
display(df.head())

```{python}
#| label: fig-polar
#| fig-cap: "A line plot on a polar axis"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = np.arange(0, 2, 0.01)
theta = 4 * np.pi * r
fig, ax = plt.subplots(
  subplot_kw = {'projection': 'polar'} 
)
ax.plot(theta, r)
ax.set_rticks([0.5, 1, 1.5, 2])
ax.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
